description: Has each new public change about a Robinhood Chain token sent to an https address as the watcher sees it, so an agent or its user hears without asking. `url` can be a Discord or Slack incoming webhook, or a Telegram bot's sendMessage URL with ?chat_id=, which get one line per change: what changed, the token, what it is worth now and the link to check it, and a second short line with the worth when it was read after the change went out. Changes that come up within 5 seconds of each other arrive as one message, a line each. Any other https endpoint gets each event as JSON, the same as brainchain_changes returns it, and later a `{type: "update", id, context}` with the finished context when the event went out unfinished, each signed: X-BrainChain-Signature is v1= and the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with `secret`, of X-BrainChain-Timestamp, a full stop and the body. Refuse a delivery whose timestamp is more than 300 seconds off. `kinds` and `tokens` keep only some changes, as in brainchain_changes. Only changes after the watch is made are sent, in order, each once. The answer has `id`, `secret` and `manageToken`. Keep all three private: the watcher shows `manageToken` only this once, and it removes the watch with brainchain_unwatch. The watcher keeps the URL to send to and never shows it again. An endpoint that fails is tried again for about two hours, then the watch is switched off; an endpoint that asks the watcher to wait (429) is waited for, which does not count as failing. The url must be https, on port 443, at a public address. One address can hold 5 watches and make 10 an hour. The watch is made on BrainChain's watcher at https://watch.usebrainchain.com, or on the one BRAINCHAIN_WATCH_URL names. Free, no key and no payment.

kinds.description: Optional: kinds to keep, such as bitgo.pr_opened, or a source's prefix, such as bitgo.

tokens.description: Optional: tokens to keep, by contract address, symbol or BitGo id.

url.description: The https address to send changes to: a Discord or Slack webhook, a Telegram bot's sendMessage URL with ?chat_id=, or your own endpoint.

name: brainchain_watch
title: Have new public changes about Robinhood Chain tokens sent to you
